text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The patient is a 33-week premature infant with respiratory distress starting 2 hours after birth, and no history of antenatal corticosteroids. This presentation is highly suggestive of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (Hyaline Membrane Disease) due to surfactant deficiency.
